sourceAnchors.claim: Main outdoor renderer treats negative field values as special icons, normalizes thousand bands, draws the current landlook base tile, then loads the normalized value via GetCIcon.
Map overview renderer repeats negative-value normalization, draws the current landlook base tile, and overlays a cicn through ploticon3.
Terrain-atlas fastplot returns immediately for negative values, proving negative special/icon values need a separate icon-aware render path.
Movement solidity checks Data Solids only for raw negative values in the -1..-998 range.
Opcode 12 writes a raw field value into the selected land/dungeon field grid, so script-mutated icon/tile changes share the same field-value model.
Outdoor terrain art comes from PICT 300 + landlook, while landlook mapstats are loaded from the matching data file.

normalization.normalizedIconId: raw + 2000 in main viewport, repeated +1000 in map overview
overview path repeats +1000 up to three times; main viewport behavior needs fixture checks

negativeFieldValueRender.exportRule: Preserve raw field value unless the user explicitly changes it; normalized icon ID is render/diagnostic metadata.
